Bill of Quantities (BOQ)
Quantity Surveying · Material Estimation · Excel
Intermediate

Prepared detailed Bills of Quantities for civil engineering projects including earthwork excavation, retaining walls, box culverts, and building foundations. Work covers reinforcement scheduling, concrete volume estimation, and material take-off using Excel-based QS templates developed during AUST coursework.

Quantity estimation for box culvert with length/width inputs and material breakdown
Full QS Report — Building (v3)
Complete quantity survey: earthwork, BFS, 25″/30″/20″ wall and column foundations
Full QS Report — Building
Quantity survey covering earthwork, column and wall foundations with volume calculations
Quantity Report 1 — Beam Reinforcement
